newsitem.title: FRANCE: HORSE RACING-FRAGRANT MIX WINS PRIX NOAILLES.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-FRAGRANT MIX WINS PRIX NOAILLES.

text.p: Fragrant Mix, ridden by Thierry
Jarnet, confirmed himself as a colt of classic potential with an
impressive win in the first of the French Derby trials, the
Group Two Prix Noailles, run over one mile and three furlongs
(2.2 kms) at Longchamp on Sunday.
It was his third successive win.
Taking the lead two furlongs (400 metres) out, the Andre
Fabre-trained colt came home an easy three lengths winner from
Sendoro, the mount of Gerald Mosse, with Shaka, ridden by
Jean-Rene Dubosc, a further half a length back in third place in
the six-horse field.
Winning rider, Thierry Jarnet, said: "There is no denying
that Fragrant Mix had a fitness advantage, as he was the only
horse in the field to have benefited from two previous outings
this term.
"Having said this, he was taking on a much better class of
opposition today and won in the style of a good horse. He is
clearly still improving".
The big disappointment of the race was Barings who failed to
justify his considerable reputation, finishing a disappointing
fifth.
